name: DUCKVADER
fix_description: In buyTokens, when _balances[msg.sender] == 0, a massive amount of tokens is minted for free. Attacker passes amount=0 (msg.value >= 0 always passes), triggering the free mint. Fix by requiring amount > 0 and removing or restricting the unconditional mint on first purchase.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward exploit of flawed token purchase/accounting logic: repeatedly calling buyTokens(0) from fresh helper contracts to receive free tokens, then consolidating and dumping them via a Uniswap router. It uses simple multi-contract repetition but no flash loans, complex state reasoning, or advanced DeFi mechanics, so a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
